sampling_law.description: the chip-cold-plate DEVELOPMENT population: uniform over the box, kept if the closed-form screen admits it (carbon.cold_plate.population)

strata.description: heat load at least 1200 W and inlet at least 40 C: the decision study's high-load boundary condition as an input region; the hot spot is unconstrained

custody.made_on: the operator host only: drawn from an owner-only custody root and committed to its journal before any use; never in the repository, never in a pool
custody.solved_on: the operator host only: never in a pod plan, rented compute, the attack knowledge store or a Graphite session

decisions: OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-05 §4 (PR #593): 60 cases plus 2 hidden duplicates from the DEVELOPMENT population law; at least one third in the boundary-stress load and inlet range

The Test Lead's delegated decision under OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-05 §4 (2026-10-05, to VALIDATOR-03): the stratum is heat_load_w >= 1200 and inlet_c >= 40.0; its quota is drawn from the population restricted to it and the rest from the whole population
